title: Placement and airflow — strict three-lane version
caption: Three separate unbranched airflow lanes pass safely beside the bed.
motif: bedroom, correct placement, three separate unbranched teal lanes, coral ghost outline
palette: warm white, pale ice, light oak, MVN teal, minimal coral warning
annotation: Version two created an extra short branch near the louver. Use three independent unbranched lanes from start to finish.
prompt: One self-contained 16:9 editorial HVAC illustration for the MVN Climate Atlas. Quiet architectural 3D, matte materials, warm-white modern bedroom, pale-ice accents, light oak and mist-gray textile. Three-quarter view, straight verticals, 38 mm lens, camera height 1.65 m, slight downward angle. Soft daylight only from upper left, gentle short shadows. One physical fictional MVN Reference Split 01 high on the right wall beside the headboard: matte warm-white rectangular body, softly rounded corners, one graphite lower seam, one continuous louver, no logo, no display. Show THREE SEPARATE UNBRANCHED TEAL LANES representing air: lane one, lane two, lane three. Each lane begins independently at the lower louver and ends independently in the open left half of the room. Each is one smooth continuous curve. The lanes never split, fork, duplicate, merge or create a short tail. There are exactly three teal curves anywhere in the image, clearly countable from unit to endpoint. Equal spacing. Teal #11B8B2. Each lane has one small left-pointing chevron integrated at its endpoint, exactly three chevrons. All three lanes stay above and to the left of the sleeping zone, not across the pillows or body. On the upper-left wall show one thin coral outline of the wrong unit position and one coral X only; no coral airflow. Add one small deep-teal measurement dot near pillow height without a connecting line. Sparse room: bed lower right, one bedside table, one small neutral vase, blank walls. Keep all essential elements in central safe area, 2400 by 1350. No fourth line, no partial line, no branch near the louver, no glow trail, no shadow interpreted as airflow, no text, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no second physical unit, no person, no additional arrows or icons, no collage, no split screen, no watercolor, no flat clipart, no glossy commercial render, no dark mood, no clutter, no floating UI. Before finalizing, visually count from the louver: exactly three teal lanes leave it and exactly three reach the left endpoints.
